title: Physical & Natural Sciences Responsible Conduct of Research
Reflections from the next generation of climate researchers
summary: [Md Nurul Kadir,](https://www.linkedin.com/in/md-nurul-kadir/) a dedicated MACH researcher from the [University of Florida](https://geology.ufl.edu/), shares his personal journey into climate science and reflects on the impact of his work. As a MACH team member, Kadir’s research aims to understand how estuarine bathymetry, or underwater topography, affects tidally driven water levels, flood risk and communities.
